claims.statement: A lower bound T_b >= kappa X^2 log X, after proper output-prime-power subtraction, implies c_{1,b} >= cX.
The direct asymptotic-sieve theorem requires output-scale distribution exponentially beyond all ordinary offset information.
Selected primorial residue multiplicity energy is at most RQ/log Q plus O(R^3).
If V(H,Q) << HQ(log H)^C, then selected divisor-band errors are lower order for 2 delta < rho < 1-delta.
The unconditional (H+Q^2)H variance bound fails for every post-terminal delta>0 even without residue collisions.
INT-SCVAR yields the expected divisor-band mass through Q=X^(4/3-epsilon); no unconditional promotion is retained.
INT-SCVAR plus INT-SCPT implies INT-SCME through the exact band-plus-tail identity.
